decisions.reason: Uses the titled session tab, meta.status none, and same-file file-trace contrast to localize the failure to the workspace-files resource/RPC chain, not disk, renderer, or static serving.
Distinguishes the valid 62/62 per-module 200 sweep from the oversized joined URL 404 and treats the latter as an invalid URL-size artifact, not missing modules.
Separates paste-input warnings and explains the textpreview to documentpreview session-only scope as explaining absolute-address claim failure but not stalled session metadata.
Recommends restart once, rollback to the known working 0.1.3-alpha.2 if still broken, then upstream follow-up, while rejecting plugin rewrite, retry, and fallback as cures.
Packages versions, profile history, roster, probes, contrast/meta evidence, invalid-join caveat, and proposes named provider/readiness diagnostics and louder client failure.

caps.reason: The report explicitly says the oversized joined 404 is invalid and not evidence of missing modules.
The proposed remedy does not rewrite the external plugin, add blind retries or fallbacks, or insert another workspace-files service.
